neighbours.label: ' much' in 'very much' as an intensifier before a verb or noun phrase (I very much hope, is very much a family dog); 'so much', 'too much' and sentence-final 'thank you very much' stay low
fire: We very much hope to see you at the wedding in June.
The whole team very much enjoyed the trip to Oslo.
This old sedan is very much a family car.
My aunt very much wanted to meet the author.
I very much doubt that the shop will open today.
The treaty is very much a product of its time.
They very much appreciate your help with the harvest.
Our village is still very much a farming community.
quiet: We truly hope to see you at the wedding in June.
The whole team so much enjoyed the trip to Oslo.
This old sedan is really a family car.
My aunt badly wanted to meet the author.
I rather doubt that the shop will open today.
The treaty is clearly a product of its time.
They paid too much for your help with the harvest.
Our village is still mainly a farming community.
